# 📚 The Prompt Library

Welcome to the definitive ecosystem of PromptLabs. This library is a curated index of every technique and specialized template we offer, designed for rapid discovery and master-level implementation.

---

## 🛠️ The Techniques Arsenal

Master the fundamental principles that govern Large Language Models. These are the core methodologies every prompt engineer must possess.

| Technique | Description | Difficulty |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **[Zero & Few-Shot](/docs/techniques/zero-and-few-shot)** | Guiding models with zero or minimal examples. | ⭐ Beginner |
| **[Chain-of-Thought](/docs/techniques/chain-of-thought)** | Eliciting step-by-step reasoning for complex logic. | ⭐⭐ Intermediate |
| **[Least-to-Most](/docs/techniques/least-to-most)** | Breaking down complex problems into sub-modules. | ⭐⭐ Intermediate |
| **[Self-Consistency](/docs/techniques/self-consistency)** | Validating accuracy through multiple reasoning paths. | ⭐⭐⭐ Advanced |
| **[Meta-Prompting](/docs/techniques/metaprompting)** | Using models to write and optimize their own prompts. | ⭐⭐⭐ Advanced |
| **[RAG (Retrieval-Augmented)](/docs/techniques/rag)** | Grounding AI outputs in external, factual datasets. | ⭐⭐⭐ Advanced |
| **[AI Orchestration](/docs/techniques/orchestration)** | Managing multi-step autonomous workflows. | ⭐⭐⭐ Advanced |

## 🧭 How to Navigate
1. **Choose a Category**: Start with a core technique if you're building a new system, or jump into a specialized library for production-ready templates.
2. **Copy & Parameterize**: Every prompt uses `{Brackets}` for easy customization.
3. **Iterate**: Use the techniques you've learned to refine the output of the specialized templates.
